positioning.en: I'm a math student in Taipei. I build small tools you can check instead of having to trust — and now and then, short films made entirely out of code.
positioning.zh: 我在台北念數學。我做的小工具有個共同點：你不必相信我，可以自己檢查。偶爾，我也用程式碼拍短片。

facts.en: Mathematics Division, Dept. of Mathematics and Information Education, National Taipei University of Education · expected 2028
facts.zh: 國立臺北教育大學 數學暨資訊教育學系 數學組 · 預計 2028 年畢業

facts.en: Python · TypeScript · open to software and AI internships
facts.zh: Python · TypeScript · 尋找軟體與 AI 實習

about.en: I study mathematics at National Taipei University of Education (Mathematics Division, Dept. of Mathematics and Information Education), graduating in 2028. My favourite moment in any project is when a claim becomes something you can check: a CI step that reads the test report instead of trusting a green light, an audit that ties a research claim to the exact bytes of its evidence, a search that hands back the counterexample along with how far it looked. When an idea doesn't work out, I keep it public — that's part of the work too.
about.zh: 我在國立臺北教育大學數學暨資訊教育學系數學組念書，預計 2028 年畢業。做專案時我最喜歡的時刻，是一個說法終於變得「可以檢查」：CI 不再只相信綠燈，而是真的去讀測試報告；研究的主張被綁到證據的每一個位元組；搜尋器交出反例時，也告訴你它找過多遠。沒有成功的想法，我也會留著公開——那也是工作的一部分。

learning.en: Lately I've been learning Lean 4 and Mathlib, mostly by building ProofWeave and working on the SAIR solver. I'm looking for a software or AI internship on a team where tests and evidence — not confidence — decide what ships.
learning.zh: 最近在學 Lean 4 和 Mathlib，大多是邊做 ProofWeave、邊做 SAIR 求解器邊學的。我正在找軟體或 AI 實習，想加入一個用測試和證據、而不是用信心來決定什麼能上線的團隊。

body.en: Before any code, I write down the question, where it stops, and what “done” will look like: which tests, which replay, which hash.
body.zh: 動手之前，我先寫下：要回答什麼問題、範圍到哪裡、怎樣才算完成——要過哪些測試、用什麼重播、比對哪個雜湊。

body.en: Claude Code and Codex (including Codex Cloud) write most of the code, tests and docs, on branches I review. Most lines here were typed by an agent; every claim is still mine to stand behind.
body.zh: 大部分的程式、測試和文件，由 Claude Code 與 Codex（含 Codex Cloud）在我審閱的分支上完成。這裡多數的程式碼是 agent 打的，但每一個主張都由我負責。

body.en: Tests, independent replays and content hashes decide what stands — not how sure I feel. Results that disappoint are published with the same care as the ones that don't.
body.zh: 留下什麼，由測試、獨立重播和內容雜湊決定，而不是看我有多有把握。令人失望的結果，也用同樣的認真公開。

methodNote.en: Even this page follows the rule: the site and my GitHub profile are generated from one catalog file, and the build refuses to pass if they disagree.
methodNote.zh: 連這一頁也照這個規則：網站和 GitHub 個人頁由同一份目錄檔產生，兩邊對不上，建置就不會通過。

filmsIntro.en: In October 2026 I made three pieces where the picture, the music and the edit are all source code. Each repository shows how it was made — and what it can’t do.
filmsIntro.zh: 2026 年 10 月，我做了三件作品：畫面、音樂和剪接，全部都是程式碼。每個倉庫都寫下了它是怎麼做出來的，以及它做不到的地方。

negativesIntro.en: Not every experiment works. These are the ones that didn't go the way I hoped — kept public, with the same frozen data as the ones that did.
negativesIntro.zh: 不是每個實驗都會成功。這些是沒有照我期待走的結果，一樣公開，一樣附上凍結的資料。

items.en: Finished three works made entirely in code: ORACLE, The Disease Called AI, and world.execute(me).
items.zh: 完成三件全部用程式做的作品：卜 ORACLE、病名為AI、world.execute(me)。

items.en: Wrote up the RuleDiff negative result as a short technical report; the RuleShift-Web paper is still a draft.
items.zh: 把 RuleDiff 的負面結果寫成一份短的技術報告；RuleShift-Web 的論文還是草稿。

items.en: Had two fixes merged into other people's projects: DeepSeek Harness Desktop and dsh-engram.
items.zh: 兩個修正被合併進別人的專案：DeepSeek Harness Desktop 與 dsh-engram。

items.en: Learning Lean 4 and Mathlib, one proof at a time, through ProofWeave and SAIR.
items.zh: 透過 ProofWeave 和 SAIR，一個證明、一個證明地學 Lean 4 與 Mathlib。

title.en: Resolved worktree paths through symlinks, so re-creating a worktree can no longer misjudge and delete uncommitted work.
title.zh: 讓 worktree 路徑先解析符號連結，重建 worktree 時就不會誤判、刪掉還沒提交的修改。

title.en: Traced claims stored in the legacy database and added a careful, conservative migration.
title.zh: 追查舊資料庫裡存放的宣稱，加上一個謹慎、保守的遷移。

title.en: Kept Windows verification failures distinguishable: a narrower native-window fallback, and standalone helper loading that works.
title.zh: 讓 Windows 上的驗證失敗分得清楚：縮小原生視窗的降級判斷，並修好獨立執行時的輔助模組載入。

projects.name: HonestCI
projects.descZh: CI 的綠燈可能是假的：測試一個都沒跑，執行器照樣回傳 0。HonestCI 是一個 CLI 與 GitHub Action，確認 JUnit 報告真的存在、是新的，而且測試數不低於你信任的基線。它不評斷測試寫得好不好。
projects.descEn: A green CI badge can lie: a test runner can exit 0 having run nothing. HonestCI is a CLI and GitHub Action that checks the JUnit reports are really there, fresh, and not below the test count you trust. It won't tell you whether the tests are any good.

projects.name: RigorGraph
projects.descZh: 替研究筆記做的本機優先 Python CLI：把每個主張連到證據檔案與獨立審查，檢查每一個 SHA-256，輸出離線稽核報告。證據改動一個位元組，稽核就會失敗。VERIFIED 代表記錄下來的流程接受了它，不代表它是真的。
projects.descEn: A local-first Python CLI for research notes: it links each claim to its evidence files and independent reviews, checks every SHA-256, and writes an offline audit report. Change one byte of evidence and the audit fails. VERIFIED means the recorded process accepted it — not that it's true.

projects.name: Verified Search
projects.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的檢索外掛：保留它引用的原文段落，也讓你看見證據在哪裡斷掉。只有 verified_search 是穩定版，另外四個擴充仍在實驗。250 個測試，尚未經過獨立驗證。
projects.descEn: A search plugin for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the passages it cites and shows you where the evidence runs out. Only verified_search is stable; four extensions are still experimental. 250 tests, no independent validation yet.

projects.name: Second Agent Kit
projects.descZh: 讓 DeepSeek Harness 在 macOS 上跑得更安全的修補：用 Seatbelt 限制 shell 指令、限制輸入呼叫次數、每個專案的記憶彼此隔離。還有哪些缺口都寫清楚了——它不是萬用防火牆。
projects.descEn: Safety patches for running DeepSeek Harness on macOS: Seatbelt sandboxing for shell commands, limits on input calls, and memory kept separate per project. The gaps are written down — it isn't a firewall for everything.

projects.name: DSH Architecture Lab
projects.descZh: 開發中的實驗室：在隔離環境（Lima VM 或 Seatbelt）裡試 DeepSeek Harness 的記憶與規劃想法，配上外部評審和費用計量。目前的結果只來自一個小型修復任務。85 個測試。
projects.descEn: A development-preview lab for trying memory and planning ideas on DeepSeek Harness in isolation (Lima VM or Seatbelt), with an outside judge and a cost meter. So far the results come from one small repair task. 85 tests.

projects.name: Finite Witness
projects.descZh: 設定一個關於小圖的猜想，瀏覽器會把 6 個頂點以內的圖全部檢查一遍，尋找反例，並交出一張憑證，讓另一支 Python 腳本獨立重播。通過搜尋是證據，不是證明。
projects.descEn: Set up a conjecture about small graphs and the browser checks every graph up to six vertices, looking for a counterexample. It hands back a certificate that a separate Python script can replay. Surviving the search is evidence, not proof.

projects.name: SAIR Proof Press
projects.descZh: 一個等式蘊涵求解器的公開伴隨站：每一題不是給出 Lean 檢查過的證明，就是給出一個有限反模型。凍結的版本通過了全部 1,669 個公開輸入，最終執行沒有呼叫任何模型。
projects.descEn: The public companion to a solver for equational implications: for each problem it produces either a Lean-checked proof or a finite countermodel. The frozen version accepted all 1,669 of the 1,669 released inputs, and the final run didn't call a model once.

projects.name: ProofWeave Core
projects.descZh: 用結構化的 Markdown 寫證明，ProofWeave 會拿固定版本的 Lean 4 / Mathlib 來檢查。它把兩件事分開回報：Lean 有沒有認證，以及有沒有人確認敘述真的是你想說的。它不做自然語言翻譯。
projects.descEn: Write a proof as structured Markdown and ProofWeave checks it against a pinned Lean 4 / Mathlib. It reports two things separately: whether Lean certified it, and whether a person confirmed the statement says what you meant. It doesn't translate natural language.

projects.name: RuleShift
projects.descZh: 一個小而確定的測試世界，用來問：規則改變時，agent 的記憶撐不撐得住？這次先導實驗裡，最簡單的檢索和比較複雜的策略表現相當（153 / 160），成本還更低。
projects.descEn: A small, deterministic test world for asking how an agent's memory copes when the rules change. In this pilot, plain retrieval did as well as the fancier strategies (153 / 160), for less cost.

negative.en: Plain retrieval matched the fancier memory strategies — the extra complexity didn't pay for itself.
negative.zh: 最簡單的檢索就和複雜的記憶策略一樣好——多出來的複雜度沒有換到成效。

projects.name: RuleShift-Web
projects.descZh: 稽核 agent 如何記住網站政策的工作台：3,200 次模型執行，對照 1,600 次控制組。意外的是，完全不用 LLM 的控制器比兩個模型都強。論文還是草稿，尚未經過審查。
projects.descEn: A workbench for auditing how agents remember web policies: 3,200 model runs against 1,600 controls. The surprise: a controller with no LLM at all beat both models. Draft paper, not yet reviewed.

negative.en: On the frozen held-out set, a controller with no LLM beat both models.
negative.zh: 在凍結的保留資料上，不用 LLM 的控制器贏過兩個模型。

projects.name: RuleDiff negative result
projects.descZh: 一份四頁的報告，記錄一個沒有撐住的結果：用詞彙預測政策影響的模型，在開發集拿到 0.99 的 macro-F1，到一組保留資料上只剩 0.67。未經同儕審查。
projects.descEn: A four-page report on a result that didn't hold: a word-based predictor of policy impact scored 0.99 macro-F1 in development, then 0.67 on one held-out packet. Not peer reviewed.

negative.en: 0.99 in development, 0.67 held out. The full-paper follow-up was stopped by the rule I'd registered in advance, and frozen as this report.
negative.zh: 開發集 0.99、保留集 0.67。依照我事先登記好的規則，完整論文的後續就此停止，凍結成這份報告。

projects.name: Charlie Alpha 4B
projects.descZh: 實驗性的 4B 模型（Qwen3.5，用 MLX 微調），在本機建議該用哪種統計方法。它在模擬基準上進步了（DGP-Regret −34%），但在 P-Bench 和 StatQA 上沒有。
projects.descEn: An experimental 4B model (Qwen3.5, fine-tuned with MLX) that suggests which statistical procedure to use, running locally. It got better on a simulator benchmark (DGP-Regret −34%) but not on P-Bench or StatQA.

negative.en: No gain on P-Bench or StatQA; only the simulator benchmark moved.
negative.zh: P-Bench 和 StatQA 沒有進步；只有模擬基準有變化。

projects.name: TokenScope
projects.descZh: 一個看進語言模型內部的雙語遊樂場：手動設定的單頭 5×5 注意力玩具、取樣旋鈕（temperature、top-k、top-p），以及一步一步的 BPE 合併。每個數字都能匯出。
projects.descEn: A bilingual playground for looking inside a language model: a hand-set one-head 5×5 attention toy, sampling knobs (temperature, top-k, top-p), and BPE merges one step at a time. Every number can be exported.

projects.name: MiniHarness
projects.descZh: Python 工作坊：分八步親手做出一個小型 agent harness，全程離線、搭配腳本化的模擬模型，附 38 個單元的繁體中文課程。用來學習，不是上線用的。
projects.descEn: A Python workshop where you build a small agent harness in eight steps — offline, against a scripted mock model — with a 38-module course in Traditional Chinese. For learning, not production.

projects.name: 卜 ORACLE
projects.descZh: 一部 4 分 30 秒的短片。凌晨三點，有人問 AI：「她會好起來嗎？」畫面用 Three.js 在無頭 Chromium 裡只靠 CPU 渲染，配樂和音效用 Python 合成。片中的史料在 README 註明出處，也標出哪些是重建的。
projects.descEn: A 4:30 short film. At 3 a.m., someone asks an AI: “Will she get better?” Rendered with Three.js on the CPU in headless Chromium; the score and sound design were synthesised in Python. The README cites sources for the historical details and marks what was reconstructed.

projects.name: 病名為AI · The Disease Called AI
projects.descZh: 一首原創歌曲和手繪水彩 MV，3 分 35 秒、67 個鏡頭。樂譜是一支 Python 程式，DiffSinger 的歌聲用固定種子逐位元重現，再讓 Whisper 聽一遍檢查咬字。
projects.descEn: An original song with a hand-painted watercolour music video — 3:35, 67 shots. The score is a Python program, the DiffSinger vocals render bit-for-bit from fixed seeds, and Whisper listens back to check the diction.
projects.made: p5.js + p5.brush · DiffSinger · Kokoro · Whisper QA

projects.name: world.execute(me); · Claude Code
projects.descZh: 把 Mili 的 world.execute(me); 演成一場 Claude Code 會話，直接在你的終端機裡即時播放。純 Node、零依賴，每一格畫面都是歌曲時間的函數。非官方同人作品，承接 MisakaZentai 的 DeepSeek Harness 版本；不含歌曲本身。
projects.descEn: Mili's world.execute(me); performed as a Claude Code session, playing live in your terminal. Pure Node, no dependencies — every frame is a function of the song's time. An unofficial fan work, after MisakaZentai's DeepSeek Harness version; the song itself isn't included.
projects.made: Node 20, zero dependencies · 24-bit ANSI · braille/sextant canvases

projects.name: DeepSeek Girl
projects.descZh: 同一套動畫、兩個非官方的家：Codex Desktop 上會朝 16 個方向看的動畫寵物，以及會隨 Session 狀態反應的 DeepSeek Harness 外掛。離線運作。
projects.descEn: One set of animations, two unofficial homes: a 16-direction animated pet for Codex Desktop, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin that reacts to what the session is doing. Works offline.
